topic: What happens if you hibernate like a bear?
title: Six Months Asleep
hook: What if you slept through the whole winter?

beats.label: 1 WEEK
beats.line: Your heart slows from about fifty beats a minute to around ten.

beats.label: 1 MONTH
beats.line: You stop eating, drinking and even peeing, for months.

beats.label: 3 MONTHS
beats.line: Your body recycles that waste into protein, so your muscles barely shrink.

beats.label: 5 MONTHS
beats.line: By now you've lost up to thirty percent of your body weight, mostly fat.

beats.label: 6 MONTHS
beats.line: In spring you wake up thinner, but strong enough to walk out.

end.line: Would you sleep all winter if you could?

description: No food, no water, no bathroom for months: how a bear's body survives the winter.

facts.claim: A hibernating black bear's heart rate can drop from about 50 to around 8-10 beats a minute.
facts.source: U.S. National Park Service - Bear hibernation

facts.claim: Black bears can go 100 days or more without eating, drinking, urinating or defecating.
facts.source: U.S. National Park Service - Bear hibernation

facts.claim: Hibernating bears recycle urea into protein and lose little muscle.
facts.source: U.S. National Park Service; NIH / NCBI - Hibernation physiology

facts.claim: Bears can lose about 15 to 30 percent of their body weight during hibernation, mostly fat.
facts.source: U.S. National Park Service - Bear hibernation
